description: A test script for the 'noop fetch negotiator' in a Git-like environment. It sets up repositories, configures parameters, executes a fetch operation, and checks trace output to verify behavior.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the specified repository.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures repository settings such as fetch negotiation algorithm.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting success with a descriptive name.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
